purpose: Define nanoCMS web services as stable named instances whose semantic identity is independent from listen port and runtime running state.

topics.name: nanoCMS Instances
topics.purpose: Define nanoCMS web services as stable named instances whose semantic identity is independent from listen port and runtime running state.

semantics.identity_rule: Every nanoCMS service instance has an explicit logical name.
semantics.binding_rule: Port/listen address is mutable binding, not instance identity.
semantics.lifecycle_rule: Declared instance existence is separate from running/stopped runtime state.
semantics.multiplicity_rule: Multiple named nanoCMS instances may run concurrently when bindings do not conflict.
semantics.public_rule: A named instance public always exists canonically.
semantics.public_state_rule: The public instance and its default port-80 binding exist canonically even when the instance is not running.
semantics.site_rule: Each instance explicitly binds to nanoCMS/#WEB site semantics.

invariants.rule: Web instances, protocol bindings and exposed surfaces retain explicit stable identity, binding, lifecycle and authority boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: port used as nanoCMS instance identity
stopping service deletes canonical instance definition
two active instances collide on incompatible listener binding
instance site binding inferred only from URL/path

references.purpose: Web instance serves explicit nanoCMS site structure.
